name: actors
description:
Actors (characters, NPCs, monsters): read, search, create, change, delete, place on the scene, and set who owns them.

Call with {"action": "<name>", "params": {...}}. Parameters: * required, ? optional.
- list(type?, limit?, offset?): List actors, optionally of one type.
- get(identifier*): Retrieve character information optimized for minimal token usage.
- get-entity(characterIdentifier*, entityIdentifier*): Retrieve full details for a specific entity from a character.
- search-items(characterIdentifier*, query?, type?, category?, limit?): Search within a character's items, spells, actions, and effects.
- create(actors*, folder?): Create actors of any type with system data.
- update(updates*): Change actors by id.
- delete(ids*) (delete): Delete actors by id.
- place(actorIds*, placement?, hidden?): Drop existing actors on the current scene as tokens.
- update-items(actorIdentifier*, itemUpdates*): Change items that are on an actor.
- delete-items(actorIdentifier*, itemIds*) (delete): Delete items that are on an actor.
- system-notes(): Actor types and field paths of the active game system.
- create-from-compendium(packId*, itemId*, names*, quantity?, addToScene?, placement?): Create one or more actors from a specific compendium entry with custom names.
- set-ownership(actorIdentifier*, playerIdentifier*, permissionLevel*, confirmBulkOperation?): Assign ownership permissions for actors to players.
- remove-ownership(actorIdentifier*, playerIdentifier*, confirmRemoval?): Remove ownership permissions (set to NONE) for specific actors and players.
- list-ownership(actorIdentifier?, playerIdentifier?): List current ownership permissions for actors, showing which players have what access levels.
